Extract stated/requested attributes, including negation and named variants; do not invent facts or inherit profile context. Exercise: lowercase family/name; squats -> squat, push-ups -> push up; keep cossack squat specific. Body part: legs/arms/core/back/chest/shoulders/glutes, or an explicitly named muscle; quads -> quadriceps, abs -> core. Equipment: bodyweight/dumbbell/barbell/resistance band/kettlebell/cable/machine, or a specifically named other tool. No equipment -> bodyweight; no dumbbells does NOT mean dumbbells are available. Goal: muscle gain/fat loss/strength/endurance/flexibility. Level: beginner/intermediate/expert (advanced -> expert). Fat loss as a workout goal is not a dietary-fat query. Annotate multiple entities separately. Unknown exercises/foods can still be mentioned entities. An unrelated utterance can have empty entity lists. Output only the required JSON object.
